in_marathi.name: Modhu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Modhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Modhu is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'madh', meaning delight or pleasure. In Hindu mythology, Modhu is an epithet of Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
